content: Tanvi Saxena called insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to discuss her upcoming health policy expiration on 30/09/2027. She confirmed the 15-day post-expiry claim window ending on 15/10/2027, expressed her intention not to renew the policy this year due to changing plans, and inquired about the non-renewal process. Sunita explained that the policy will lapse automatically and confirmed she will send a final closure statement after the claim window. Finally, Tanvi requested and was promised an updated policy PDF via email.

action_items: Allow policy to automatically expire on 30/09/2027
Send final policy closure statement and pending claims summary after the claim window
Resend the updated policy PDF via email to the customer
